title: Pictures folder
whyItMatters: Personal photos and screenshots, often with locations and dates in the file names and metadata. Photos of documents and screens are common here too.
source: Windows known folder Pictures, default path under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: If OneDrive Known Folder Move is on, the real Pictures folder is under %USERPROFILE% OneDrive. Camera Roll and Screenshots may sit inside rather than beside it.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy what you want to keep to an external drive or your cloud account before deleting anything in this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and look through it before deleting anything.
Check for the same files in OneDrive if the folder looks empty, because Known Folder Move can redirect it.
Copy what you keep to a drive you are taking with you, then delete the rest.
cleanup.risk: Photos deleted here are gone unless you copied them out first. Cloud albums may hold copies, so check them before deleting.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
